about_the_game:
UNYIELDER: PROLOGUE

Step into the world of UNYIELDER! This new demo introduces more weapons, bosses, environments, and an improved combat system. Offering a refined look at the fast-paced, fluid action and a newly introduced prologue, this demo sets the stage for the full game!

More Enemies, More Challenges

Meet the new bosses:

A fresh spin to familiar friends

A brand-new IMPERIUM foe to face, ROOK!

... and a special surprise.


A Vastly Expanded Arsenal

Your weapons define your playstyle, and the Steam Next Fest demo gives you more firepower than ever before:

🔹 New weapons: CALDERA, DOWNPOUR and BASTET!

🔹 Expanded weapon mod system that transforms every weapon into a force to be reckoned with
🔹 New multi-tiered perk system makes every run unique - every tier grants strange new perks to test out!

🔹 Break the game with up to 40 unique perks for nigh-infinite combinations

Every shot, dodge, and moment counts—now with even smoother combat and movement refinements! Explore every perk and weapon to find which one suits you best!
 

Battle it Out in New Environments!

The world of UNYIELDER expands with new levels. Battle through Watchtower, DOCKSGRAVE, Cavity, and Depot, each bringing unique challenges and verticality to movement and combat. With Arenas custom-crafted to provide the best shooting experiences, it’s best to watch your back, or the bosses will get the drop on you!

You will also gain access to your new home, HOUSE OF CARDS, where you can test weapons, improve your mastery of various talents, and more!

Save Your Progress for the Full Game

Your time in EREBUS will be immortalized past this demo - your PRETENDER’s character upgrades will carry over to the full game!

Get the Most Out of the Demo
For more details on weapons, movement, and scoring strategies, check out the Demo Guide linked on this page or join us on Discord to share your own tips and tricks. Learn how to optimize your arsenal, improve your runs, and uncover hidden secrets.

EREBUS is ready for you.
NEVER YIELD.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains guns and graphical violence.
